mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO alert_cooldown(device_key, rule_code, last_occurred_at) VALUES (#{deviceKey}, #{ruleCode}, 0)

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM alert_event WHERE message_id = #{messageId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_event(message_id, device_key, rule_code, scene, level, title, content, occurred_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{deviceKey}, #{ruleCode}, #{scene}, #{level}, #{title}, #{content}, #{occurredAt,typeHandler=com.intelli.home.adapter.out.persistence.typehandler.EpochMillisTimestampTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_cooldown SET last_occurred_at = #{occurredAt} WHERE device_key = #{deviceKey} AND rule_code = #{ruleCode}
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, device_key, rule_code, scene, level, title, content, occurred_at FROM alert_event ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
